name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Robes
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Robes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear. Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful. Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look. Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.
I will give you an illusionist's robe, friend... But earn your place of reverence among the tribe first! Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned with the Paragons of Power we need? I know it will not be easy... But I have long predicted an outsider would come to aid us in our fight against Hakkar. Let it be you, I say!

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last, someone worthy to wear the illusionist's robe! Your success in Zul'Gurub has assured your reverences amongst the tribe for ages to come. Wear it with pride, friend!
